name: PublishTerraformPlan
description: Publish a Terraform binary plan with generated JSON, or publish an existing JSON plan as a build artifact.
author: Freeson Li
helpMarkDown: Provide planFile to convert and publish a binary plan using the same Terraform version and initialized directory, or provide jsonFile to publish existing plan JSON without Terraform. Plan files can contain unredacted sensitive values; artifact access follows the pipeline's permissions.

inputs.name: planFile
inputs.label: Binary plan file (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Existing binary plan created by terraform plan -out. Relative paths resolve against Working directory. The artifact preserves the binary file's name. Leave empty when supplying jsonFile.

inputs.name: jsonFile
inputs.label: Existing JSON plan file (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Existing Terraform plan JSON to publish when planFile is empty. Relative paths resolve against Working directory. Terraform is not required for this mode.

inputs.name: jsonFileName
inputs.label: JSON plan filename
inputs.helpMarkDown: Filename inside the artifact, ending in .plan.json so the Terraform Plans tab can discover it.

inputs.name: artifactName
inputs.label: Artifact name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Build artifact containing the plan files. Use a distinct name for each invocation in a run.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base directory for relative input paths. For binary conversion, use the initialized Terraform directory including its provider plugins.

inputs.name: terraformCliPath
inputs.label: Terraform CLI path (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the Terraform executable for binary conversion. Leave empty to use terraform from PATH. Use the version that created the binary plan. Ignored when publishing existing JSON.
